description: This source file defines the internal partial class 'MessageFactory' within the Orleans.Runtime namespace. The class is responsible for creating various types of messages used in Orleans communication, such as general messages, responses, rejection responses, and diagnostic status messages. It manages message IDs, correlation IDs, and incorporates tracing and logging functionalities.

classes.name: MessageFactory
classes.description: An internal partial class used to generate different types of messages within the Orleans messaging system.

methods.name: CreateMessage
methods.description: Creates a new IMessage with specified body and options, setting appropriate flags and generating a correlation ID.

methods.name: CreateResponseMessage
methods.description: Creates a response message based on a request message, copying relevant fields.

methods.name: CreateRejectionResponse
methods.description: Creates a rejection response message for a given request with specified rejection type, info, and optional exception.

methods.name: CreateDiagnosticResponseMessage
methods.description: Creates a diagnostic/status response message with provided diagnostics information and status flags.
